# Markitai

> Opinionated Markdown converter with native LLM enhancement support. Converts documents, images, and URLs to clean Markdown, with optional LLM cleaning, frontmatter metadata, vision analysis, OCR for scans, and a local web workspace.

One native program (`markitai`, alias `mkai`, and `markitai-mcp`) with a local REST/web workspace (`markitai serve`), an MCP server (`markitai mcp`), and Python (PyPI `markitai`), Node.js and Go bindings of the same Rust engine. Install: `curl -fsSL https://markitai.dev/setup.sh | sh` (macOS, Linux) or `irm https://markitai.dev/setup.ps1 | iex` (Windows), or `pip install markitai`. Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/Ynewtime/markitai. Docs are bilingual: English at the site root, 简体中文 under `/zh/`.

License: markitai is MIT. Its Rust dependencies are under permissive licences (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, Zlib, Unicode and similar) and, for four CSS-parser crates, the file-level MPL-2.0; none is GPL. Release archives and wheels carry the notices. See NOTICE for full third-party attribution: https://github.com/Ynewtime/markitai/blob/main/NOTICE

## Automation

- `markitai input -o out/ --json` returns final per-item status, output paths, usage and costs; check the exit code and `ok`/`error`. `--dry-run` and `--llm-batch-collect` exclude JSON output. Usage errors exit 2 with no JSON.
- `markitai input -f json` prints one versioned document object (`schema_version` 1.0) instead of Markdown.
- `--no-remote-fetch` disables remote URL extraction; it does not disable separately enabled LLM enhancement or a Cloudflare file backend. By default `auto` URL fetching stays on the machine.
- MCP tools: `convert_document`, `convert_url`, `batch_convert`, `job_status`; paths must be absolute. Conversions accept `profile`; batches accept `concurrency` (default 10) and isolate outputs by batch/item. Omitted `llm` inherits server configuration; `llm: false` disables it.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://markitai.dev/guide/getting-started): Install (the setup script, release archives, pip/uv, building from source), first conversion, output structure, supported formats, platform notes
- [Upgrading from 1.x](https://markitai.dev/guide/upgrading): What changed from the Python markitai 1.x: install, CLI, output, configuration, Python API
- [Why Markitai](https://markitai.dev/guide/comparison): How markitai compares with markitdown, docling and anydoc, and which job each tool optimizes for
- [CLI Reference](https://markitai.dev/guide/cli): Every command and flag
- [Output Profiles](https://markitai.dev/guide/output-profiles): rag/obsidian/okf output shaping, frozen images.json schema, LlamaIndex ingestion recipe
- [Python API](https://markitai.dev/guide/python-api): `convert`/`aconvert` with typed results (provisional), plus the Node.js, Go and C bindings
- [MCP Server](https://markitai.dev/guide/mcp): `markitai-mcp` exposing conversion tools to AI agents over stdio
- [Configuration](https://markitai.dev/guide/configuration): Config file and env vars, LLM providers, image/screenshot/OCR settings, cache, security
- [Fetch Policy](https://markitai.dev/guide/fetch-policy): URL fetch strategy cascade (static/local browser, then Defuddle/Jina/Cloudflare once allowed), domain profiles, remote-fetch consent
- [Web Workspace](https://markitai.dev/guide/serve): `markitai serve` local UI, access token, job history, REST + SSE API
- [Web Workspace Reference](https://markitai.dev/guide/serve-reference): Access and user tokens, model rules, Edit config, the REST API and its error codes
- [Claude and Copilot](https://markitai.dev/guide/subscriptions): use a Claude Code or GitHub Copilot subscription through the official CLIs
- [ChatGPT](https://markitai.dev/guide/subscription-chatgpt): use a ChatGPT subscription through the Codex CLI
- [Prices and Cost](https://markitai.dev/guide/pricing): how a conversion is priced, what an unknown price means, the spending limit
- [Conversion Performance](https://markitai.dev/guide/performance): what keeps a run fast, diagnosing a slow run
- [Changelog](https://markitai.dev/changelog): Release history

## 中文文档

- [快速开始](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/getting-started): 安装（安装脚本、发布包、pip/uv、从源码构建）、首次转换、输出结构、支持格式、平台说明
- [从 1.x 升级](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/upgrading): 与 Python 版 markitai 1.x 相比的变化：安装、命令行、输出、配置、Python API
- [为什么选 Markitai](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/comparison): 与 markitdown、docling、anydoc 的对比，以及每个工具各自优化的目标
- [CLI 命令](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/cli): 完整命令与参数参考
- [输出 Profile](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/output-profiles): rag/obsidian/okf 输出塑形、冻结的 images.json schema、LlamaIndex 摄取示例
- [Python API](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/python-api): `convert`/`aconvert` 与类型化结果（暂定阶段），以及 Node.js、Go 与 C 绑定
- [MCP 服务器](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/mcp): `markitai-mcp` 通过 stdio 向 AI Agent 提供转换工具
- [配置说明](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/configuration): 配置文件与环境变量、LLM 提供商、缓存、安全设置
- [抓取策略](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/fetch-policy): URL 抓取策略级联、域名配置、远程抓取同意
- [Claude 与 Copilot 订阅](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/subscriptions): 通过官方命令行使用 Claude Code 或 GitHub Copilot 订阅
- [ChatGPT 订阅](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/subscription-chatgpt): 通过 Codex 命令行使用 ChatGPT 订阅
- [价格与费用显示](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/pricing): 转换如何计费、价格未知意味着什么、费用上限
- [网页工作台](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/serve): `markitai serve` 本地界面、访问令牌、历史记录、REST + SSE API
- [工作台参考](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/serve-reference): 访问令牌与用户令牌、模型规则、编辑配置、REST API 与错误代码
- [转换性能](https://markitai.dev/zh/guide/performance): 让转换更快的做法、慢速转换排查
- [更新日志](https://markitai.dev/zh/changelog): 发布历史
